test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

a. Peace of mind is commonly correlated with happiness, contentment, tranquility, contemplation, exercise and relaxation.

b. Thus, we all need peace of mind in our lives.

c. Peace of mind, thus, give us all these attributes.

d. One of the most important aspects of the mind is getting peace.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **dacb**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph discusses the importance of peace of mind and its relation to happiness, contentment, and relaxation.
 
• The logical sequence starts with the importance of peace of mind (d).
 
• It then explains the attributes correlated with peace of mind (a).
 
• Following this, it states that peace of mind provides these attributes (c).
 
• Finally, it concludes with the necessity of peace of mind in our lives (b).

Therefore, the correct answer is **dacb.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (bdca):** This option starts with the necessity of peace of mind, which skips the introduction of the importance and attributes related to it.
 
• **Option 3 (bcda):** This option also starts with the necessity of peace of mind, creating a disjointed sequence.
 
• **Option 4 (dcba):** This option starts correctly but ends with the necessity of peace of mind, which should be the concluding sentence.
